title: Fat Worm Blows a Sparky
build: original Durell Software release, tape image made with Ramsoft MakeTZX; a BASIC wrapper loads a 190-byte self-overwriting turbo loader at $FAF2 which loads 49001 bytes to $4000

credits.role: contributor (Spectrum Computing lists him; his role there is unstated)

tools.emulator: release ZEsarUX-13.0, ZEsarUX_macos-silicon-13.0.dmg; check-emulator 36 of 40 (the three with workarounds, plus stopwatch, which fell below its 0.5x floor on a busy host)
tools.disassembler: SkoolKit 10.1 (its simulator was also used to run individual routines, and sna2ctl.py to cross-check the code/data split)

regions: $5B00-$62FF is generated at boot by $EBF0-$EC59 - the 256-entry bit-reverse table at $6200-$62FF and the pre-shift pages below it - so it is not authored data. The rest of the range is the board's own records, which the walker at $AF49 steps through 7 bytes at a time ($AF43 loads $0007 into BC), not 8.
the shape and picture data selected by 18 words in the pointer table at $BF27 ($C011, $C02D, ... $C279); the region is referenced by address, by those pointers
the pre-rendered picture $7F30 copies onto the screen for the opening menu

the game's variable block: $8000 a per-frame counter that $9CF1 clears, $8001 the heading, $8002/$8003 the projection scale and speed, $8059 the frame counter, $805D the sparkie count, and the object and cursor pointers and counters around them. The entity count is not in this range: it is at $7C71.
the four 16-byte board panel records start_new_game copies down from $7FA4
